questionnaireTemplate.title: HEALTHWITHRESHMI — Pre-Consultation Health & Nutrition Questionnaire
questionnaireTemplate.subtitle: Section B through Section F (Flexible Clinical History & Biomarkers)
questionnaireTemplate.notice: After payment, please fill this questionnaire to give Reshmi Verma a comprehensive clinical picture. It is not mandatory to answer every question — answer what is most relevant to your goals.

sections.title: Section B — Your Main Health Concern
sections.description: Help us understand your primary health focus and how long it has persisted.

questions.text: What is your primary health concern?
Please describe your main concern in your own words.
questions.placeholder: Describe the symptoms, frequency, and when they started...

questions.text: How long have you been experiencing this concern?
How much does this concern affect your daily life?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Affects work focus, daily energy, mood, sleep...

questions.text: Have you consulted a healthcare professional about this concern?
What have you tried so far, and what results did you experience?
questions.placeholder: Medications, home remedies, diets, supplements, therapies...

sections.title: Section C — Health History
sections.description: Medical diagnoses, surgeries, medications, and laboratory data.

questions.text: Have you been diagnosed with any medical condition? If yes, please specify.
questions.placeholder: e.g., Hypothyroidism, Fatty Liver, IBS, Hypertension, None...

questions.text: Are you currently taking any medicines or supplements? Please list their names, if known.
questions.placeholder: e.g., Thyronorm 25mcg, Pantoprazole 40mg, Vitamin D3, B12, None...

questions.text: Do you have any known food allergies or intolerances?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Lactose/Dairy, Gluten, Nuts, Shellfish, Soy, None...

questions.text: Have you undergone any surgery or had a significant medical event relevant to your nutrition?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Gallbladder removal, C-section, Appendectomy, None...

questions.text: Do you have recent laboratory reports that you would like the nutritionist to review? (Optional secure note/link)
questions.placeholder: e.g., CBC, Lipid Profile, Thyroid Panel (can share on Google Meet or paste link)...

questions.text: Is there any other health information the nutritionist should know before your consultation?
questions.placeholder: Family history, genetic predispositions, or specific concerns...

sections.title: Section D — Body & Lifestyle Profile
sections.description: Physical measurements, movement, sleep patterns, and stress profile.

questions.text: Height (cm)
Current weight (kg), if comfortable sharing
Has your weight changed significantly in the last 3–6 months? If yes, describe the change.
questions.placeholder: e.g., Gained 3 kg, Lost 5 kg unintentionally, Stable...

questions.text: How physically active are you?
On average, how many hours do you sleep each night?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 6–7 hours, fragmented, mouth breathing at night...

questions.text: How would you describe your current stress level?
Do you smoke, consume alcohol, or use other substances that may be relevant to your health? (Optional and confidential)
questions.placeholder: Strictly confidential medical note (e.g. Occasional social drinks, Non-smoker)...

sections.title: Section E — Food & Nutrition Habits
sections.description: Dietary preferences, meal timings, digestion, and hydration.

questions.text: Which best describes your dietary preference?
What time do you usually eat breakfast, lunch and dinner?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Breakfast: 9:00 AM, Lunch: 1:30 PM, Dinner: 9:00 PM

questions.text: Please describe a typical day's meals and snacks.
questions.placeholder: Morning tea/coffee, breakfast items, afternoon lunch, evening snack, dinner...

questions.text: Approximately how much water do you drink daily?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 2–3 litres, 4–5 glasses...

questions.text: Do you regularly experience bloating, acidity, constipation, diarrhoea or other digestive symptoms? If yes, describe them.
questions.placeholder: e.g., Bloating 30 mins after meals, acidity in morning, sluggish bowels...

questions.text: Are there any foods you avoid due to preference, culture, allergy or intolerance?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Avoid dairy, avoid onion/garlic, avoid red meat...

questions.text: How often do you eat outside or order food?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 2–3 times a week, weekends only, rarely...

questions.text: What makes it difficult for you to maintain your desired eating habits?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Busy work schedule, travel, sugar cravings, lack of meal prep time...

sections.title: Section F — Your Goals & Expectations
sections.description: Your primary aspirations, realistic time dedication, and expectations.

questions.text: What is your primary goal from this consultation?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Eliminate acid reflux permanently, boost daytime energy, optimize gut microbiome...

questions.text: What would meaningful improvement look like to you?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Feeling light after meals, waking up refreshed, clear skin...

questions.text: Have you previously followed a nutrition or diet plan? What worked or did not work?
questions.placeholder: e.g., Tried keto (too restrictive), tried intermittent fasting (gave acidity)...

questions.text: What kind of support would help you most?
How much time can you realistically dedicate to making changes?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 20–30 minutes daily for cooking/breathing, gradual step-by-step changes...

questions.text: Is there anything else you would like to discuss with the nutritionist?
questions.placeholder: Any other questions or comments for Reshmi Verma...
